description: A release step's smoke check exits 1 for any HTTP status other than 200, so a 204 or 304 from the health endpoint fails the deploy. The reviewer rated it a low hardening note because the endpoint usually answers 200. HTTP defines 204 and 304 as successes, and the step isn't retried: it holds the merge.

findings.title: A 304 from the health endpoint fails the deploy check
findings.body: The check exits 1 unless the status is 200. Behind the CDN the health endpoint can answer 304 Not Modified or 204 No Content, which would fail the release. It usually answers 200.
